verdict.rationale: DBOS docs confirm cron-based scheduled workflows that can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime (dbos-docs-7), and Conductor provides pause/restart controls plus API/CLI scripting (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-17, dbos-docs-18). However, there is no explicit evidence of overlap policies (e.g., skip/allow concurrent runs) or a UI/API view showing upcoming scheduled run times. missing for 10: overlap-policy configuration, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, independent hands-on confirmation of scheduling behavior.
